description: This file is a C header defining interfaces for a WAN manager module, including function declarations, type definitions, and external dependencies related to WAN mode management, configuration, and event handling.

classes.name: wan_manager_app_t
classes.description: Structure holding pointers to the WAN manager's core components: the data model, parser, and context.

methods.name: _wan_manager_main
methods.description: Main entry point for WAN manager logic, handling reasons, data model, and parser.

methods.name: wan_get_dm
methods.description: Returns the current data model object for WAN management.

methods.name: wan_get_parser
methods.description: Returns the parser object used by the WAN manager.

methods.name: _WANModeEnable
methods.description: Enables the WAN mode for a given object.

methods.name: _WANModeDisable
methods.description: Disables the WAN mode for a given object.

methods.name: _setWANMode
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode based on provided arguments.

methods.name: _setIPv4Mode
methods.description: Configures IPv4 mode.

methods.name: _setIPv6Mode
methods.description: Configures IPv6 mode.

methods.name: _Reset
methods.description: Resets WAN configuration.

methods.name: _getWANMode
methods.description: Retrieves current WAN mode.

methods.name: _set_wan_mode
methods.description: Internal function to set WAN mode based on event data.

methods.name: _check_wan_mode
methods.description: Validates the requested WAN mode.

methods.name: _interface_already_configured
methods.description: Checks if the interface is already configured.

methods.name: is_valid_mode_list
methods.description: Checks if a list of modes is valid.

methods.name: _dm_wan_manager_physical_type_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in physical WAN type.

methods.name: _wan_sensing_priority_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in WAN sensing priority.

methods.name: _dm_wan_manager_wan_added
methods.description: Handles event when a new WAN interface is added.

methods.name: _wan_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a WAN interface object.

methods.name: _interface_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an interface object.

methods.name: _app_start
methods.description: Starts the WAN manager application with event data.
